name: mlsys-code-walkthrough
description: Write rigorous ML-systems code walk-through tutorials in the Awesome-ML-SYS-Tutorial style: pick a lifecycle (a request, a training step, a weight update), find the 3-6 data structures that carry state across it, and walk it stage by stage with Allocate/Write/Update/Free mutations, mermaid data-flow diagrams, Excalidraw hero figures, and commit-pinned source permalinks. Targets SGLang, vLLM, slime, verl, Megatron, and similar ML-systems repos.
